objectClass.notes: A reference-guided marketing approximation of one cast metallic object; not a manufacturing model.

reasoning: The overall silhouette is simple, but the identity depends on physically readable concentric relief, recessed marks, a wrapped blue line, and multiscale metallic surface breakup.
A shallow hierarchy is sufficient because the object is one cast body and only the whole-object pivot moves.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Macro silhouette, meso identity assemblies, micro relief/material breakup, and one root inspection pivot are all required.

unknownsToResolveBeforeImplementation: Underside and rear-face geometry are hidden; keep them simple and explicitly inferred.
Exact real-world dimensions and chamfer radii are unavailable; use normalized proportions only.
Blue-line relief and medium are ambiguous; default to a flush shallow inlay without claiming exact construction.
Exact assay-well depth and ring profile are inferred from a single three-quarter view.
Exact glyph outlines are unavailable; use a close geometric approximation and grade legibility, not font identity.

detailInventory.note: Each detail maps to a named component local feature or material local override in the final spec.

definitionOfDone: At the reference camera, the model reads immediately as the same low cast-silver assay monolith rather than a generic rounded box.
The assay bowl, concentric rings, blue line, `Ag / 47`, and three front ticks remain legible at desktop hero size.
Satin-metal highlight breakup survives neutral and grazing light without becoming mirror chrome or flat gray plastic.
Desktop and mobile use the same static fallback; WebGL remains optional and nonblocking.

featureGroups.name: Shallow cast monolith silhouette
qualityCriteria: Approximate 4.8:1.7:0.72 proportions, softened plan corners, broad uneven perimeter bevel, and slight top crown are explicit.
failureModes: height or depth overwhelms the long low profile

featureGroups.name: Concentric assay well
qualityCriteria: Multiple rings and the recessed bowl produce real parallax, occlusion, and grazing highlights.

featureGroups.name: AG identity marks
qualityCriteria: Blue wrapped line, recessed `Ag / 47`, and three front ticks are placed and proportioned from visible evidence.

featureGroups.name: Satin poured silver response
qualityCriteria: Independent albedo, roughness, normal, and AO responses include macro mottle, meso brushing/dents, and micro scratches.

featureGroups.name: Optional restrained inspection
qualityCriteria: One root pivot supports low-amplitude pointer inspection; reduced motion and static fallback remain first-class.

visualDeltaChecks: ring count, diameter, depth, and negative-space bowl
satin metal roughness and multiscale relief
reference camera, cream background, and soft rightward contact shadow
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not replace the assay well with a flat texture.
Do not model the monolith as an unmodified sharp BoxGeometry.
Do not reuse albedo as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not claim hidden-face or manufacturing accuracy from this single image.
Do not proceed to visual acceptance without same-camera desktop and mobile renders plus a static-fallback check.

localSpecSearch.query: cast metal monolith rounded cuboid concentric relief

index.reason: The security-curated workflow uses direct reference observation; no object-specific local adapter was required.

authoringInstruction: Author a reference-specific ObjectSculptSpec; retain all single-image limitations and production runtime constraints.
